title: Plant domestication, production intensification and food storage at Pre-Pottery Neolithic A Dhra‘
version: Levant, online version dated 17 January 2018, doi:10.1080/00758914.2018.1424746
lineage: Author-uploaded full text of the online version, with the two authors shown in that copy. Analyzes charred macroremains from the same excavation as Kuijt and Finlayson’s architecture and preliminary phytolith study.

passages.locator: Dhra′ cereal densities, context 2134 and table 5
passages.note: A flotation sample from the layer between the floor and collapsed material in Structure 4 yielded charred barley grains at an above-average density for the site. The evidence concerns this sampled deposit associated with Structure 4.
